targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ai.anomalies WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ai.forecasts WHERE predicted_value>=threshold_value AND $__timeFilter(generated_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events.correlated_incidents WHERE status='open' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ai.rca_findings WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at)
SELECT observed_at AS time,actual_value AS "Actual",baseline_value AS "Baseline" FROM ai.anomalies WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT generated_at AS "Generated",site_id AS "Site",asset_id AS "Asset",metric_name AS "Metric",round(predicted_value::numeric,1) AS "Predicted",round(threshold_value::numeric,1) AS "Threshold",predicted_breach_at AS "Predicted Breach",round((confidence*100)::numeric,1) AS "Confidence %",model_name AS "Model" FROM ai.forecasts WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at) ORDER BY generated_at DESC

SELECT started_at AS "Started",incident_key AS "Incident",site_id AS "Site",severity AS "Severity",status AS "Status",root_asset_id AS "Root Asset",correlated_event_count AS "Correlated Events",array_to_string(impacted_services,', ') AS "Impacted Services",round((correlation_confidence*100)::numeric,1) AS "Confidence %",summary AS "Summary" FROM events.correlated_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC

panels.title: Root Cause Analysis and Recommended Action

targets.rawSql: SELECT generated_at AS "Generated",incident_key AS "Incident",site_id AS "Site",root_asset_id AS "Root Asset",probable_cause AS "Probable Root Cause",round((confidence*100)::numeric,1) AS "Confidence %",service_impact AS "Service Impact",array_to_string(evidence,' • ') AS "Evidence",recommendation AS "Recommended Action" FROM ai.rca_findings WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at) ORDER BY generated_at DESC
